metadata.algorithm: exact conditional permutation moments and corpus-wide maximum z
metadata.rng: Python random.Random, MT19937; shuffle per page reused across clocks
metadata.seed_scope: control generator only; never a candidate key
metadata.zero_variance_rule: z=0 and adjusted p=1; constant residual tolerance is 64 binary64 eps times max(1, max_abs_weight)
metadata.p_adjusted_rule: (1 + count(control family maximum z >= observed candidate z))/(B+1)
metadata.family: all supplied page-by-clock candidates, deduplicated by full per-rune delta vector
metadata.interpretation: Global within-page exchangeability null; significant unigram alignment is a lead, not decipherment; absence of a lead is limited to this scorer and family
